title: わけ: the underlying reasoning
summary: わけ is a noun for the reasoning link between facts: そんなわけで (for that reason), わけが分からない, わけではない and わけがない.

blocks.text: Dictionaries list a pile of meanings for **わけ**: reason, cause, conclusion, circumstances. The course unites them: わけ is a **noun** for the **reasoning link** between facts, the logic that joins a cause to a result in either direction. It is related to 分ける and 分かる: to divide, to break down so that it becomes clear.

The reasoning link works in both directions. "Sakura was out in the rain, so she's wet" goes from cause to result. "Sakura is wet, so she must have been out in the rain" goes from result back to cause. **わけ** is that link, and it is a noun, so a describer clause can sit in front of it.
毎日練習した | わけだ: わけ is a noun, and だ makes it the engine.
**わけだ** says "that's the reasoning: it follows", so it often means "no wonder".

blocks.jp: 毎日練習したのだから、上手なわけだ。
blocks.en: He practiced every day, so no wonder he's good.

blocks.text: It is also what you say when a mystery clicks into place. A detective who has just solved the case says that it was that reasoning all along.

blocks.jp: そうか、そういうわけだったのか。
blocks.en: I see, so that's how it was!

blocks.jp: そんなわけで、宿題を忘れました。
blocks.en: For that reason, I forgot my homework.

blocks.text: **わけが分からない** means "the reasoning doesn't compute": it is nonsense.

blocks.jp: この説明ではわけが分からない。
blocks.en: I can't make sense of this explanation.

blocks.text: The next two are built from the same pieces as lesson 7. **〜わけではない** (ではない, "isn't that") says that this conclusion cannot be drawn: "it's not that...". **〜わけがない** (がない, "doesn't exist") says that no such reasoning exists at all, so it cannot be the case: "there's no way...".

blocks.jp: お金が足りないわけではない。
blocks.en: It's not that I'm short of money.

blocks.text: わけではない does not deny the fact; it only denies the reasoning. With **〜からといって** ("just because"), the idea is easy to see:

blocks.jp: 安いからといって、いつも買うわけではない。
blocks.en: Just because it's cheap, it doesn't mean I always buy it.

blocks.jp: さくらが嘘をつくわけがない。
blocks.en: There's no way Sakura would tell a lie.

blocks.text: わけがない can also mean "there's no reason to". And **わけない** on its own (with no が) means "easy, a piece of cake". Context tells you which one is meant.

blocks.jp: こんな小さい店に、そんなにお金が要るわけがない。
blocks.en: There is no reason such a small shop would need that much money.

blocks.jp: ひらがなを読むのは、わけない。
blocks.en: Reading hiragana is a piece of cake.

items: **わけ**: the reasoning or logic linking facts (a noun).
**そんなわけで**: for that reason.
**〜わけではない**: it doesn't follow that...
**〜わけがない**: there is no reasoning for it, so it can't be; **わけない**: easy.

questions.instruction: Which sentence says "It's not that I dislike cats"?
options: 猫が嫌いなわけがない。
猫が嫌いなわけではない。
questions.note: 〜わけではない: that conclusion cannot be drawn.

questions.instruction: Which sentence says "There's no way there is snow in a place like this"?
options: こんな所に雪があるわけがない。
こんな所に雪があるわけではない。
こんな所に雪があるわけだ。
こんな所に雪があるわけで。
questions.note: 〜わけがない: there is no reasoning for it, so it can't be.

questions.instruction: Fill the gap
questions.prompt: 毎日走っているのだから、足が速い＿＿だ。
questions.en: He runs every day, so no wonder he's fast.
questions.note: 〜わけだ: the reasoning fits, "no wonder".

questions.instruction: Fill the gap
questions.prompt: お金がないのに、あんな高い車を買える＿＿＿ない。
questions.en: With no money, there's no way (he) can buy such an expensive car.
questions.note: 〜わけがない: no way.

questions.instruction: Fill the gap
questions.prompt: きらいな＿＿＿ではないが、あまり食べない。
questions.en: It's not that I dislike it, but I don't eat it much.
questions.note: 〜わけではない: it doesn't follow that I dislike it.

questions.instruction: Fill the gap
questions.prompt: この問題は難しくて、＿＿が分からない。
questions.en: This problem is hard and I can't make sense of it.
questions.note: わけが分からない: the reasoning doesn't compute.

questions.instruction: What is わけ at its core?
options: A noun for the reasoning link between facts
questions.note: It is the logic joining a cause to a result.

questions.instruction: Which family of words is わけ related to?
options: 食べる / 食べさせる
questions.note: To divide so that it becomes clear.

questions.instruction: How do わけではない and わけがない differ?
options: ではない: no way; がない: it doesn't follow
ではない: "it doesn't follow that..."; がない: "there's no way"
questions.note: One denies a conclusion; the other denies that any reasoning exists.

questions.instruction: Pick the closest English
questions.prompt: そんなことを言うわけがない。
options: It's not that he says it
There's no way he would say such a thing
questions.en: There's no way (he) would say such a thing.
questions.note: わけがない: no such reasoning exists.

questions.instruction: What does わけではない do here?
questions.prompt: 寒いわけではないが、上着を着る。
options: Says that the conclusion "I'm cold" cannot be drawn
questions.en: It's not that I'm cold, but I'll wear a jacket.
questions.note: It denies the expected reasoning.

questions.instruction: Tap the word that means "reasoning link"
questions.en: It's not that I dislike school.
questions.note: わけ: the reasoning link; わけではない denies the conclusion.

questions.instruction: Tap the word that means "no wonder"
questions.en: It's raining, so no wonder the road is wet.
questions.note: わけだ: the reasoning fits.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.prompt: There's no way a child can lift this.
questions.en: There's no way a child can lift this.
questions.note: Verb + わけがない.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.prompt: It's not that I can't swim.
questions.en: It's not that I can't swim.
questions.note: Verb + わけではない.

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.prompt: He works late every night, so no wonder he's tired.
questions.en: He works late every night, so no wonder he's tired.
questions.note: Reason first, then わけだ for "no wonder".

questions.instruction: Build the sentence
questions.prompt: I can't make sense of the teacher's talk.
questions.en: I can't make sense of the teacher's talk.
questions.note: わけが分からない: it doesn't compute.

questions.instruction: True or false? わけ is a noun.
questions.note: It is the noun for the reasoning link.

questions.instruction: Fill the gap
questions.prompt: そういう＿＿で、今日は行けません。
questions.en: For that reason, I can't go today.
questions.note: そういうわけで: for that reason.

questions.instruction: What does わけが分からない mean?
questions.note: The reasoning does not add up.

questions.instruction: True or false? 〜わけがない means "it is not necessarily so, but it is possible".
questions.note: It means there is no way it can be.

questions.instruction: Which sentence says "It's not that I'm busy"?
questions.note: わけではない denies the conclusion.

questions.instruction: What does わけない mean here?
questions.prompt: 漢字を読むのは、わけない。
questions.en: Reading kanji is a piece of cake.
questions.note: わけない (with no が) means easy; context decides.

questions.instruction: Which sentence means "Just because it's expensive doesn't mean it's good"?
options: 高いからといって、いいわけではない。
高いからといって、いいわけがない。
questions.note: 〜わけではない denies the conclusion, not the fact.
